meta.tagline: Software is free. You pay for what scales.
meta.description: We rebuilt the tools you use every day as open source (AGPLv3). Self-host them free, forever, or use Zerosoft Cloud: a free plan, and you pay only for what scales.

hero.sub: Software is free. You pay for what scales. We rebuilt the tools you use every day as open source: self-host them for $0, forever, or let us run them for you, with a generous free plan.

manifesto.label: 0.01 — Manifesto
manifesto.p1: They charge you $30 to move cards. $50 to store contacts. $12 to shorten a link. Not for the software — out of habit.
manifesto.p2: But software is bits. And bits are free. They always were.
manifesto.p3: Zerosoft exists to prove it: we rebuild the tools that run the world and set the core free under AGPLv3. No lock-in. No fine print. Host it yourself, free, forever. Or we run it for you: you start free and pay only for what scales — clicks, bookings, emails, storage, seats. With prices in the open.
manifesto.final: Software is dead. We are what comes next.

model.label: 0.03 — The model
model.title: Three ways to have it.
model.titleDim: The core is free in all of them.

a.title: Self-host it
a.desc: The core is open source under AGPLv3, with every core feature included. Run it on your server, modify it, break it, make it yours. No trial, no license key, no limits.

b.title: Zerosoft Cloud
b.desc: We run it for you: login, backups, updates and uptime. Start on a generous free plan and, as you scale, pay for usage — clicks, bookings, emails, storage, seats. Transparent prices, published before we ever charge you.

c.title: Enterprise
c.desc: A commercial license with direct support from the team, on your servers or in our cloud. Enterprise extras (SSO/SAML, audit logs, custom roles, white-label) are in development.

end.label: 0.04 — Join us
end.sub: Six tools are already free. Write to us and we will tell you when the next one lands.
